description_en: Modifies the configuration items of a Data Security Center (DSC) connection authorization
description_zh: 调用ModifyDataLimit修改DSC连接授权的配置项
name: ModifyDataLimit

parameters.help_en:
The language of the request and response messages. Valid values:

zh: Chinese (default)
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
请求和返回消息的语言类型。取值：

zh：中文（默认）
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en:
The unique ID of the data asset that belongs to the product associated with the DSC connection authorization configuration item.
To modify a DSC connection authorization configuration item, you must provide the unique ID of the data asset that belongs to the associated product. You can call the [DescribeDataLimits](~~DescribeDataLimits~~) operation to obtain the ID
parameters.help_zh:
DSC连接授权的配置项所属产品的数据资产的唯一标识ID。
修改DSC连接授权的配置项时，需要提供其所属产品的数据资产的唯一标识ID，可调用[DescribeDataLimits](~~DescribeDataLimits~~)接口获取
parameters.name: id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the product to which the data of the DSC connection authorization configuration item belongs. Valid values:
1: MaxCompute
2: OSS
3: ADS
4: OTS
5: RDS
parameters.help_zh:
DSC连接授权的配置项数据所属产品的名称。取值：
1：MaxCompute
2：OSS
3：ADS
4：OTS
5：RDS
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en:
The region where the asset resides. Valid values:
cn-beijing: China (Beijing)
cn-zhangjiakou: China (Zhangjiakou)
cn-huhehaote: China (Hohhot)
cn-hangzhou: China (Hangzhou)
cn-shanghai: China (Shanghai)
cn-shenzhen: China (Shenzhen)
cn-hongkong: Hong Kong (China)
parameters.help_zh:
资产所在的区域。取值：
cn-beijing：华北2 （北京）
cn-zhangjiakou：华北3（张家口）
cn-huhehaote：华北5 （呼和浩特）
cn-hangzhou：华东1 （杭州）
cn-shanghai：华东2（上海）
cn-shenzhen：华南1 （深圳）
cn-hongkong：中国香港
parameters.name: service_region_id

parameters.help_en: The username used for the DSC connection authorization to the RDS database
parameters.help_zh: DSC连接授权RDS数据库的用户名称
parameters.name: user_name

parameters.help_en: The password used for the DSC connection authorization to the RDS database
parameters.help_zh: DSC连接授权RDS数据库的用户密码
parameters.name: password

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to modify the username and password for connecting to the database. Valid values:
true: Modify.
false: Do not modify
parameters.help_zh:
是否修改连接数据库的用户名和密码，取值：
true：修改
false：不修改
parameters.name: modify_password

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable auditing. Valid values:
0: Disable auditing.
1: Enable auditing
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启审计。取值：
0：不开启审计
1：开启审计
parameters.name: audit_status

parameters.help_en:
The retention period of raw logs after auditing is enabled. Unit: days. Valid values:
30
90
180
365
parameters.help_zh:
开启审计之后，原始日志的保存时间（单位：天）。取值：
30
90
180
365
parameters.name: log_store_day

parameters.help_en:
The database type. Valid values:
MySQL
SQLServer
parameters.help_zh:
数据库类型。取值：
MySQL
SQLServer
parameters.name: engine_type

parameters.help_en: The port used to connect to the database
parameters.name: port

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to automatically trigger a rescan when rules change. Valid values:
0: Do not trigger an automatic scan.
1: Trigger an automatic scan.  

When a rule change triggers an automatic scan, a full scan is performed on all data in the data source
parameters.help_zh:
是否在规则发生变更时，自动触发重新扫描。取值：
0：不触发自动扫描
1：触发自动扫描  

规则变更触发自动扫描时，会对数据源中的所有数据进行全量扫描
parameters.name: auto_scan

parameters.help_en:
The number of sample entries for sensitive data detection after data detection is enabled. Valid values:
0
5
10
parameters.help_zh:
指定开启数据识别后，敏感数据采样条数。取值：
0
5
10
parameters.name: sampling_size

parameters.help_en: The VPC ID to which the data asset belongs
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en: The security groups used by PrivateLink in agent-based auditing
parameters.name: security_group_id_list

parameters.help_en: The vSwitches used by PrivateLink in agent-based auditing
parameters.name: vswitch_id_list

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. Alibaba Cloud generates a unique ID for each request. You can use the ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
